value.content: {"id": "portswigger_clickjacking", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "clickjacking", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: Clickjacking (UI Redressing)", "name": "Clickjacking & Frame Framing Resistance Audit Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-1021", "owasp_category": "A05:2021 - Security Misconfiguration", "signals": ["missing_x_frame_options", "missing_frame_ancestors_csp", "frame_options_allow_all", "frame_bust_script_bypassable", "sensitive_action_prefilled"], "verification_strategy": "Audit HTTP response headers of authenticated endpoints for X-Frame-Options (DENY/SAMEORIGIN) and Content-Security-Policy (frame-ancestors 'none'/'self'). Construct a benign framing iframe in Firefox to verify whether rendering is blocked.", "evidence_requirements": ["header_inspection_log", "iframe_render_proof", "dom_element_position_map"], "tools": [{"tool": "BrowserAgent (Firefox)", "cmd": "BrowserAgent.check_frameable(url)", "desc": "Loads URL within cross-origin iframe inside Firefox-esr to verify framing denial"}, {"tool": "httpx", "cmd": "httpx -u 'https://example.com/account' -probe-headers 'X-Frame-Options,Content-Security-Policy'", "desc": "Checks presence of defensive framing control headers"}], "remediation": "Configure Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self'; or X-Frame-Options: DENY. Protect sensitive workflows with re-authentication or multi-factor confirmation.", "description": "PortSwigger Clickjacking labs explore basic iframe UI overlays, clickjacking with prefilled form inputs, frame-busting script bypasses via sandbox attributes, and multi-step clickjacking exploiting drag-and-drop mechanics."}
